version answers with the base version, the resolved impact, the commits that
set the signal floor, the commits that carry no signal, and the next
version. It is read-only and invokes no producer.

bump is major, minor or patch, and names the impact instead of using the
signal floor: the highest impact the commits' Release-Type trailers,
conventional types and breaking markers indicate. A named bump over commits
that indicate none prints a warning. A named bump below the signal floor is
refused: exit 1, no answer, and standard error names the floor and the
commits that set it.
Without --target, the release line is the configured target, or else the
branch origin/HEAD points to. Exits 1, after printing the answer, when no
release is warranted or the version policy refuses the version.

Usage:
  release version [bump] [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for version
      --json            Render the answer as JSON instead of YAML
      --target branch   The release line to compute for: a branch (default: the configured target, else the branch origin/HEAD points to)

Global Flags:
      --config file   Use this configuration file instead of discovering one
  -C, --repo path     Operate on the repository at this path instead of the working directory
